import json
from collections import Counter

all_notes = []
for i in range(1, 4):
    with open(f'/tmp/page{i}.json') as f:
        d = json.load(f)
        notes = d.get('data', {}).get('notes', [])
        all_notes.extend(notes)

print(f"Total notes: {len(all_notes)}")

# Title keywords
titles = [n['title'] for n in all_notes]
print("\n--- Titles ---")
for t in titles:
    print(f"  {t}")

# Note types
types = Counter(n['note_type'] for n in all_notes)
print(f"\n--- Note Types ---")
for k,v in types.most_common():
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")

# Tags
all_tags = []
for n in all_notes:
    all_tags.extend(n.get('tags', []))
tag_counter = Counter(all_tags)
print(f"\n--- Tags (top 20) ---")
for k,v in tag_counter.most_common(20):
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")
print(f"  Total unique tags: {len(tag_counter)}")

# Content length
content_lens = []
for n in all_notes:
    content = n.get('content', '')
    content_lens.append(len(content))
    
print(f"\n--- Content Length Stats ---")
print(f"  Mean: {sum(content_lens)/len(content_lens):.0f} chars")
print(f"  Min: {min(content_lens)}")
print(f"  Max: {max(content_lens)}")

# AI generated

print(f"\n--- AI Generated ---")
print(f"  AI generated: {ai.get(True, 0)}")
print(f"  Human written: {ai.get(False, 0)}")

# Empty content

print(f"\n--- Empty Content ---")
print(f"  Empty/blank: {empty}")
